proposals.title: Verify scorer invariances and expression-coordinate pairing before geometry modelling
proposals.claim: An asymmetric synthetic-cloud suite will determine which scorer terms respond to frame, size and expression-coordinate pairing changes, without needing biological targets.
proposals.mechanism: Translate/rotate/scale/reflect clouds and permute rows jointly or expression alone. Compare d2_shape, occupancy_dice, scale_log_ratio and neighborhood_mmd with fixed sampling. Inspect axis degeneracy separately; do not assume website mirror-equivalence from proper sign flips alone.
proposals.falsifier: Once the official scorer is available, run frozen transformations. Any reproducible deviation from the documented invariance kills the asserted conformance and blocks relying on it until implementation is understood.

evidence.says: Imports common and scoring, which the audited source tree does not supply; local scorer equivalence is not established.
Mandates absent geometry/scoring artifacts; historical numbers here are not directly verified experiments.

evidence.ref: Virtual Embryo Challenge official T2 scoring, 2026, https://virtualembryo.ai/challenge/evaluation?section=scoring&task=2
evidence.says: Documents coordinate invariances, separate size scoring and coupling-independent neighbourhood profile comparison.

proposals.title: Require coordinate provenance before interpreting scale as biological growth
proposals.claim: A provenance gate will prevent an undocumented physical-unit conversion or coverage difference from being labelled validated biological growth.
proposals.mechanism: Record units, per-axis spacing, frame handedness, section coverage and exclusions before interpreting scale_log_ratio. Preserve calibrated raw coordinates separately from RMS-normalised shape coordinates. Flag rather than silently correct unidentified distortions.
proposals.falsifier: Supply two identical biological clouds under different documented unit conversions and a cropped version. If the audit labels their raw RMS differences as validated growth, the proposed gate fails.

evidence.says: Coordinate validation checks array shape and finite values, without verifying physical units or acquisition coverage.

evidence.ref: Clifton et al., STalign, Nature Communications 14:8123, 2023, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-43915-7
evidence.says: Models partially matched sections and nonlinear distortions, assessing correspondence with independent landmarks and expression.

peer_responses.on: Scorer conformance and unit provenance do not establish anatomical topology or boundary-aware graphs.
peer_responses.because: Accepted. Need registered structural segmentation, coverage masks and handed landmarks; synthetic cavity/density/coverage controls distinguish graph shortcuts. Neurl IPS 2026/agent_orchestrator.py:144 checks only finite coordinates.

declined: Reject anchor-derived target rescaling: anchors are evaluation calibration, not justified target anatomy. Reject unconditional diffeomorphic developmental interpolation because new structures and uncertain correspondence are not identified by sparse snapshots.
